update_log: Baseline initialization of modern Olympic history, India's historical milestones, and latest performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics for Sports Static GK.

history_of_modern_olympics.key_fact: Initiated by Baron Pierre de Coubertin, who founded the International Olympic Committee (IOC). 14 nations participated.
The Olympic flag featuring the five interlaced rings (representing the five inhabited continents) was flown for the first time.
The Olympic flame was lit for the first time in the modern era, though the torch relay tradition began later in 1936 (Berlin).
Women competed in the Olympics for the first time, participating in events like tennis and golf.

indias_historical_milestones.key_fact: An Anglo-Indian athlete who won two silver medals in athletics, making India the first Asian nation to win an Olympic medal.
Won a Bronze medal in Wrestling. He was the first athlete from independent India to win an individual Olympic medal.
Won a Bronze medal in Weightlifting (69 kg category), becoming the first Indian woman to step on the Olympic podium.
Won Gold in the Men's 10m Air Rifle event.
Won Gold in the Men's Javelin Throw, becoming independent India's first track and field Olympic medalist.
The Indian Men's Hockey team has won an astounding 8 Gold medals (6 consecutively from 1928 to 1956), 1 Silver, and 4 Bronze medals in Olympic history.

india_at_paris_2024.details: India won a total of 6 medals (1 Silver, 5 Bronze), ranking 71st in the overall medals tally. This tied with London 2012 as India's second-highest medal count.

india_at_paris_2024.sport_and_medal: Shooting - Bronze (Women's 10m Air Pistol) & Bronze (Mixed 10m Air Pistol Team)
india_at_paris_2024.key_fact: Created history by becoming the first Indian in the post-independence era to win TWO medals in a single edition of the Olympics.
Became the most successful individual Indian Olympian by adding a Silver to his historic Tokyo Gold.
At 21 years old, he became the youngest ever Indian to win an Olympic medal.
Partnered with Manu Bhaker to secure India's first-ever team medal in Olympic shooting.
Made it India's biggest ever haul in a single sport (3 medals in shooting) at a single Olympics.
Secured back-to-back Olympic medals in Hockey for the first time in 52 years, defeating Spain for the Bronze.
